changelog:
🎉 Welcome to Ragya 1.0! The initial public release after extensive internal beta testing:

• High-fidelity local audio playback with gapless controls and queue management
• Dynamic real-time audio visualizers (Topographic Waves, Concentric Rings, Winamp Classic, and more)
• Full-featured Lyric Sync Studio to time, edit, and embed synchronized lyrics directly into track files
• Advanced metadata editor with tag management and custom album artwork picker
• Dual listening categorization: explore tracks by mood vibes (~) and listening contexts (#)
• Modern Jetpack Compose design with dynamic Material You themes and responsive landscape support
